lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll practice two tiny words that we almost never say completely. They are... …AND and OF! Listen: they almost disappear in speech. a cup of tea

Saying them fast is what gives English its rhythm and speed. Saying AND and OF slowly makes every sentence sound long and heavy.
